richiami.difetto: The front brake disc mounting bolts may not have been fully tightened at the factory. Additionally the rear wheel spokes may not have been fully tightened.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check the torque of the front brake disc mounting bolts and then to replace the bolts with thread locked bolts and torquing to specification. Check the tension of the rear wheel spokes and where necessary tighten the rear wheel spokes.
richiami.titolo: FRONT BRAKE DISC MOUNTING BOLTS MAY NOT BE FULLY SECURE
